answer: Replica keys cannot claim one slope-survey slot. Lock 16.8 POA and collect ticket SV-417 at desk TR-9. In 29 minutes walk 85 m along the west terrace, cross plank FP-6 on the stone bridge, and set staff ST-12 on bolt B-3 so the clinometer reads 14.6 degrees toward summit mark SM-8 at 312.4 m. Two clerks drawn from SHA-256(seed||ticket||k), k=0..1, re-sight the angle and tape the span. If the staff misses the bolt, the angle sits outside 14.4-14.8, or the ticket was reused, 6.7 POA stays locked and the key is parked five epochs; 10.1 POA returns after a later ticket on a new bolt and staff.
